definitions.explanation: The traditional Japanese custom of admiring the autumn moon, especially the full moon in mid-September ({十五夜|じゅうごや}). Involves displaying pampas grass and eating rice dumplings.
A style of serving food with a raw egg on top, where the yolk resembles the full moon. Common with soba, udon, and hamburgers.

notes:
CULTURAL NOTE:
Moon viewing ({月見|つきみ}/お{月見|つきみ}) is one of Japan's traditional autumn customs, centered on ⟦{十五夜|じゅうごや}→十五夜：24745_juugoya⟧ (the 15th night of the 8th lunar month, usually mid-September). People display {薄|すすき} (pampas grass) and offer {月見|つきみ}⟦{団子|だんご}→団子：04959_dango⟧ (rice dumplings) to appreciate the harvest moon.

Sense 2 comes from the resemblance of a raw egg yolk to the full moon. {月見|つきみ}そば and {月見|つきみ}⟦うどん→うどん：05182_udon⟧ are standard menu items at noodle shops. McDonald's Japan's seasonal {月見|つきみ}バーガー has become a cultural event.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- お{月見|つきみ}: moon viewing (polite)
- {月見|つきみ}⟦{団子|だんご}→団子：04959_dango⟧: moon-viewing dumplings
- {月見|つきみ}そば: soba with a raw egg
- {月見|つきみ}バーガー: moon-viewing burger (seasonal)
